sql: SELECT r.team, r.seats, r.seat_plan, p.landed_prs, b.billed_usd, b.billed_usd / p.landed_prs AS usd_per_landed_pr FROM desk_roster.roster r JOIN (SELECT team, COUNT(*) AS landed_prs FROM ci_silo.pull_requests WHERE merged_at IS NOT NULL AND checks_green AND NOT reverted GROUP BY team) p ON p.team = r.team LEFT JOIN (SELECT workspace, SUM(CAST(amount_usd AS DOUBLE)) AS billed_usd FROM desk_invoices.lines_sample GROUP BY workspace) b ON b.workspace = r.team ORDER BY r.team
